title: Work: esqueleto del monorepo (npm workspaces, TypeScript strict, lint)
objective: Dejar armado el monorepo de agents-panel con npm workspaces (`apps/api`, `apps/web`, `packages/shared`), TypeScript en modo `strict` y lint funcionando desde la raíz, según "Stack y convenciones de código" de `CLAUDE.md` y la estructura de `docs/plan.md`. Es la base sobre la que arranca la etapa 4 (Panel MVP); no incluye funcionalidad del panel.

tasks.title: Raíz del monorepo: workspaces, tsconfig strict, ESLint y Prettier
tasks.description: Crear package.json raíz (private, workspaces apps/* y packages/*, engines.node >=24), .nvmrc, tsconfig.base.json con strict y opciones estrictas extra, eslint.config.js (flat, typescript-eslint type-aware) y Prettier, más scripts raíz build, typecheck, lint, format y format:check que delegan en los workspaces.
tasks.context: CLAUDE.md 'Stack y convenciones de código'. Node 24 LTS (v24.21.0 en la VM). Respetar .gitignore y .gitattributes existentes (LF). No commitear node_modules.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json raíz declara workspaces apps/* y packages/* y engines.node >=24
npm install en la raíz termina sin errores y genera package-lock.json
npm run lint y npm run format:check existen y corren desde la raíz

evidence.summary: Root monorepo: package.json (private, ESM, workspaces packages/* and apps/*, engines.node >=24) with build/typecheck/lint/format/format:check scripts; .nvmrc 24; tsconfig.base.json with strict plus noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes and other strict flags; eslint.config.js flat config with typescript-eslint strictTypeChecked + stylisticTypeChecked (projectService); Prettier config. TypeScript pinned to ~6.0.3 because @angular/compiler-cli 22 requires >=6.0 <6.1 and typescript-eslint 8 requires <6.1.

validations.note: no TS sources yet; config loads and lints eslint.config.js
Markdown excluded from Prettier to keep hand-written docs untouched

checkedCriteria: package.json raíz declara workspaces apps/* y packages/* y engines.node >=24
npm install en la raíz termina sin errores y genera package-lock.json
npm run lint y npm run format:check existen y corren desde la raíz

findings.detail: Root scripts build and typecheck exist but currently fail with 'No workspaces found' because apps/ and packages/ do not exist yet (expected until W2). They are not acceptance criteria here, but must be re-verified once workspaces are added.

The root typecheck script hardcodes '-w @agents-panel/shared' (a package not yet created); it couples the root to a future package name. Confirm W2 uses exactly that name, or use npm's workspace ordering instead.

eslint.config.js uses projectService type-aware linting for **/*.ts, but there is no root tsconfig.json (only tsconfig.base.json); any .ts file outside a workspace with its own tsconfig would fail to lint. Fine for now; keep in mind for W2+.

tasks.title: packages/shared: tipos compartidos
tasks.description: Crear @agents-panel/shared con tsconfig que extiende la base, build a dist/ con declaraciones y un tipo de ejemplo HealthResponse exportado desde src/index.ts.
tasks.context: Es el contrato entre api y web; debe poder importarse como @agents-panel/shared desde ambos workspaces.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build -w @agents-panel/shared genera dist/ con .js y .d.ts
El paquete exporta el tipo HealthResponse
Typecheck y lint del paquete sin errores

evidence.summary: Created @agents-panel/shared (ESM, exports map with types/default pointing at dist) with tsconfig extending tsconfig.base.json (rootDir src, outDir dist, declarations). src/index.ts exports HealthStatus and HealthResponse { status, version }. Root build and typecheck scripts now find the workspace and pass.

checkedCriteria: npm run build -w @agents-panel/shared genera dist/ con .js y .d.ts
El paquete exporta el tipo HealthResponse

findings.detail: HealthStatus is only the literal 'ok'; if the health endpoint may later report degraded states, widen the union then. Fine for the skeleton.

tasks.title: apps/api: Fastify mínimo con /api/health
tasks.description: Crear @agents-panel/api con Fastify, endpoint GET /api/health tipado con HealthResponse de shared, escucha en 127.0.0.1:3000 (configurable por env), scripts dev, build y start.
tasks.context: Sin auth, Agent SDK ni SQLite en este Work. El panel escucha solo en 127.0.0.1:3000 (docs/plan.md).
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build -w @agents-panel/api compila sin errores
Al arrancar, GET http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health responde 200 con un HealthResponse
El servidor no escucha en 0.0.0.0 por defecto
Typecheck y lint del workspace sin errores

evidence.summary: Created @agents-panel/api: Fastify 5 app factory (src/app.ts, buildApp) with GET /api/health returning a HealthResponse typed from @agents-panel/shared; src/main.ts listens on HOST/PORT env with defaults 127.0.0.1:3000 (loopback only). Scripts: dev (tsx watch), build/typecheck (tsc), start (node dist/main.js). No auth, Agent SDK or SQLite.

validations.note: HTTP 200 {"status":"ok","version":"0.0.0"}; ss shows LISTEN on 127.0.0.1:3000 only

evidence.notes: npm 11 reports esbuild postinstall (pulled by tsx) as not covered by allowScripts; tsx works without it via the platform-specific esbuild binary. filesToTouch listed main.ts and app.ts as planned.

checkedCriteria: npm run build -w @agents-panel/api compila sin errores
Al arrancar, GET http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health responde 200 con un HealthResponse
El servidor no escucha en 0.0.0.0 por defecto
Typecheck y lint del workspace sin errores

findings.detail: apps/api/package.json imports @agents-panel/shared (src/app.ts) but does not declare it in dependencies; it only resolves via the npm workspaces symlink. Add "@agents-panel/shared": "0.0.0" (or "*") to dependencies so the workspace graph and build order are explicit.
main.ts: PORT is parsed with Number() without validation; an invalid PORT (e.g. 'abc') yields NaN and only fails inside listen. Consider validating and failing fast with a clear message.
APP_VERSION is hardcoded '0.0.0' in app.ts, duplicating package.json version; could be read from package.json later.

tasks.title: apps/web: Angular standalone + signals
tasks.description: Crear @agents-panel/web como app Angular mínima (standalone, signals, sin NgModules) con un componente raíz que use un tipo de shared, angular-eslint integrado al lint raíz y build con ng build.
tasks.context: Angular standalone + signals según CLAUDE.md. Más adelante el backend sirve este build; acá solo tiene que compilar.
acceptanceCriteria: npm run build -w @agents-panel/web genera el bundle sin errores
La app usa bootstrapApplication y no tiene NgModules
El componente raíz usa al menos un signal e importa un tipo de @agents-panel/shared
Lint con angular-eslint y typecheck strict sin errores

evidence.summary: Created @agents-panel/web from an Angular 22.2 CLI scaffold trimmed to the minimum: bootstrapApplication with appConfig (no NgModules, no router, zoneless default), root component App (src/app/app.ts, standalone, OnPush) with inline template using signals title and health typed as HealthResponse from @agents-panel/shared. tsconfig.json extends tsconfig.base.json (strict) with bundler resolution, DOM lib and strictTemplates/strictStandalone; tsconfig.app.json used by angular.json. eslint.config.js adds angular-eslint tsRecommended + inline template processing + template recommended/accessibility for apps/web. Also declared @agents-panel/shared as an explicit dependency in apps/api and apps/web (W3 reviewer warning).

validations.note: ng build production bundle ~96 kB raw / 29 kB transfer, output apps/web/dist/web
tsc strict over shared, api and web
eslint --print-config shows @angular-eslint rules active on apps/web/src/app/app.ts
shared, api and web build in order

evidence.notes: Root component file is src/app/app.ts (Angular 22 naming) instead of the planned app.component.ts. npm 11 skips install scripts of @parcel/watcher, esbuild, lmdb and msgpackr-extract (not in allowScripts); the build works with their prebuilt binaries.

checkedCriteria: npm run build -w @agents-panel/web genera el bundle sin errores
La app usa bootstrapApplication y no tiene NgModules
El componente raíz usa al menos un signal e importa un tipo de @agents-panel/shared
Lint con angular-eslint y typecheck strict sin errores

findings.detail: Root component lives in apps/web/src/app/app.ts (Angular 22 naming) instead of the planned app.component.ts listed in filesToTouch; acceptable, documented in maker notes.

The web 'typecheck' script runs plain tsc over tsconfig.app.json, which does not type-check templates; strictTemplates is only enforced by ng build. Consider 'ng build' or ngc-based typecheck if template type safety must be part of npm run typecheck.

npm 11 skips install scripts for @parcel/watcher, esbuild, lmdb and msgpackr-extract; build works with prebuilt binaries on ARM, but consider declaring allowScripts explicitly to avoid surprises on a clean VM install.
